hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: The feature flag `monthly-spend-feature` was flipped from off to on at 14:18, rolling out code in src/io_shop/spend_summary.py that raises ZeroDivisionError on the account page. Error rate jumped from ~1% to 21-38% in the same minute the flag evaluations flipped to on.

supporting_evidence.claim: ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero at src/io_shop/spend_summary.py:32 (first appearance; no such error in any minute before 14:18)
INFO io-shop: monthly-spend-feature=off - 200 evaluations (every minute 13:48 through 14:17, with only UpstreamTimeout errors at 0-3%)
error_rate 0.01 at 14:17:00Z rising to 0.27 at 14:18:00Z and staying 0.21-0.38 through 14:23, with request_volume flat at 1200

hypotheses.summary: Alternative: a code change/deploy introduced the bug in src/io_shop/spend_summary.py and the flag flip merely exposed it. No deploy is recorded, so this is unsupported by the change channel.

supporting_evidence.claim: Every recorded change to io-shop from 2026-09-16T14:18:00Z to 2026-09-17T14:18:00Z: (nothing changed in this window)
